name: Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., a biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, and commercialization of pharmaceutical products in Mainland China. The company uses synthetic biology technology to develop and deliver recombinant biologic drugs. Its products include KJ017, a recombinant human hyaluronidase for subcutaneous drug delivery; KJ103, a recombinant immunoglobulin G (IgG)-degrading enzyme for IgG-mediated autoimmune diseases; and SJ02, a long-acting recombinant human follicle-stimulating hormone carboxyl-terminal peptide fusion protein (FSH CTP) for assisted reproduction.
